reviews.text: Hi I got some frozen krill fish food cubes from you. Please note they are expired (well 'best before' was in August) which I didn't notice until I was on the train. Can I use them this far past the date? Please check your other stock. Staff were helpful and nice otherwise.

I had a great experience at Angel Pet Supplies. The shop is well stocked with everything you could need for your pets, and the staff are genuinely kind and helpful.

Women over rudely put the phone down before I could even enquire about something…

Was in London for the day (from Birmingham) so thought I’d grab some much needed pet products as I had 6 hours in the city. Checked store availability times and rang them multiple times to check they were defo open and that they had my product in stock. I was left on a ringing out phone on 3 separate occasions. I find this extremely unprofessional. Google said store was open, their website too & there was nothing on their site to say there was a closure due to an emergency. At least put a voicemail up if there was. I called at different points within an hour around 11am and still, just rang out till I couldn’t stand the AirPod in my ear any more. Sad, as I prefer to give my business to smaller independent stores than the larger franchises. I do hope they’ll read this and improve as I always give honest, fair & truthful reviews.

Perfect little place to buy your pets what they need.

Overall a very well stocked shop.
A good range of pet supplies and friendly, helpful staff. I could even phone ahead and check that they had what I needed, which I was happy about.

Good selection of food, but I bought dry food for my cat and she got sick from it. I checked the expiry date and it had expired 4 months before I bought it. Maybe it's because it's not a popular brand (it's insect protein), but still, they need to be better about checking their stock!
My favourite pet shop. They always have all we need and staff members are so friendly, kind and patient 💓 …
